Strategy: Apply the sweet-band reward between thirty and fifty only when at least five bins are open, keeping the mid penalty always on. This widens the gated band to cover more residual sizes, but the wider bonus may reward many bins and blur into Best Fit.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 50 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
